no public highest-live-end trim/grow API; reserved block size is not live logical tail
conditional allocation-time merge differs from immediate release-time coalescing
Logger.cpp link dependency; not fully header-only
RTXMU source absent from current pinned native SDK; old SDK copy is not current authority

limits: not whole-chain backend or numerical identity
inclusive overlapping stages must not be added
partial contracts and the 53-candidate inventory do not certify complete migration
ordinary backend-independent semantics retained; only supported native integration allowed
remainingDifferences: Original dense topology/table refresh scans at transaction granularity
Original dirty TLAS input preparation and full native TLAS build
Official hidden swapchain and backbuffer wait not bypassed
